name: Minimocursor
isnote: A basal neornithischian; no clade below Ornithischia is defined in this volume yet, and analyses (e.g. Fonseca et al. 2024) disagree on how basal neornithischians are related.
sum: A basal neornithischian from the Phu Kradung Formation of Thailand, whose name means "smallest runner".
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; named by Manitkoon and colleagues in 2023.
